home.title: Emirimu gy'Okukola ku Muntu Yenna Alabirira Omuntu
home.description: Emirimu gy'okukola egy'obwereere ku buli alabirira omuntu: emirimu gy'emikono, ebintu eby'abaana, emirimu egy'okukolera awamu n'endowooza ennyangu ez'okukola emirembe.
home.eyebrow: Bwereere · Tewali birango · Tewali kwewandiisa · Tewali saawa ebala wadde obubonero
home.lede: Funa emirimu egikwatagana n'omuntu, embeera n'ebyo by'olina. Emirimu gy'emikono egy'amangu, okutonda kw'abaana, ebintu eby'okukola awamu n'endowooza ennyangu ez'okukola emirembe, nga mulimu enkola ennyangu n'kaadi okusaasaanya. Oyinza okuyimirira buli kiseera ky'oyagala.
facts: Kikola ku ssimu, taabuleti ne kompyuta
home.heroApp: Era waliwo app ey'obwereere eya iPhone, iPad ne Android, ng'erimu n'ebifaananyi by'amaka gammwe kyennyini
home.gamesLede: Buli gumu muteefu, gwa bantu bakulu era gwangu okutandika. Mulondemu gumu, mutuule wamu, era mukolagane mu kukoona ku kisaaniiko.

steps.title: Londa ekintu eky'amanyi
steps.text: Ebifaananyi by'ebikopo by'amawayi, ennimiro z'ebimuli, ebisolo by'awaka n'ebyombo by'omumazzi. Tewali kusoma oba mateeka ga kusoooka kuyiga.

steps.title: Mutuule wamu
steps.text: Baleke bakooneko. Mwogerere ku bifaananyi. Ebifaananyi bwe biba tebifaanaganye, kyangu kiba kilinda kukoona kuddako.

steps.title: Mulekere awo nga mukyanyumirwa
steps.text: Omuzannyo gumu kiba kyokukola ekyamalirizibwa. Ebigambo “Kikomekkerezeddwa leero” bibeerawo bulijjo ku lutimbe.

home.stageTitle: Ebirowozo ku byokukola mu buli mutendera
home.stageLede: Ennyimba, emirimu gya bulijjo, okujjukirako ebintu by'edda n'ebiseera ebiwummuliza omwoyo, nga bitegekeddwa okusinziira ku ekyo ekisanyusa mu kiseera kino.

stages.title: Omutendera ogusooka
stages.text: Mweyongere okukola ebyo bye baagala, nga mukolawo enkyukakyuka ntono: ebyo bye balina nabyo omukwano, okufulumako, emizannyo gy'ebigambo n'okuteekerateekera awamu.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogusooka

stages.title: Omutendera ogwa wakati
stages.text: Emirimu egyangu era egy'amanyi egigabanyiziddwamu emitendera: okuzinga, okusunsula, ennyimba, emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi n'okutambulako akatamba.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogwa wakati

stages.title: Omutendera ogw'oluvannyuma
stages.text: Okwegumya n'okukwatagana okuyitira mu kukwatako, amaloboozi n'okulaba: okulabirira emikono, ennyimba ze baagala ennyo, ebifaananyi n'okubeerera awamu.
stages.label: Ebirowozo ku mutendera ogw'oluvannyuma

home.specificHtml: Onoonya ekintu ekimu ky'enjawulo? Gezaako emirimu n'emizannyo ku bantu abalina Alzheimer's, emizannyo gy'obwongo n'emizannyo gy'omu mmeeza, emizannyo gy'okwogera oba emizannyo gy'obwongo.
home.approachLede: Emizannyo mingi egy'"okukola obwongo" gizimbibwa ku sipiidi, ebiwandiiko n'emirundi egy'okuwangula. Ku muntu akooye, atali mulamu oba alina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, kiyinza okuba ng'ekigezo. Ffe twakoze ekirala ekyo ekitali kyekyo.

principles.title: Tewali kulemererwa
principles.text: Tewali saawa ebala, bubonero, bulamu bwa muzannyo oba kuwangulwa. Ekifaananyi ekitafaanana kiba kuwummulamu katono, ssi nsobi.

principles.title: Ebifaananyi bisigala nga byeyoleka
principles.text: Okutegedde kisinga okukijjukira. Okufaanaganya kutandika nga buli kimu kirebwa obulungi, n'olwekyo tewali kintu kye mwetaaga kujjukira mu mutwe.

principles.title: Kya bantu bakulu era ekitiibwa ky'omuntu kikuumibwa
principles.text: Ebigambo eby'ekisa era ebyangu n'ebifaananyi eby'ebintu ebya ddala. Tetukozesa bintu bya baana bito wadde ebigambo eby'abaana abawere.

principles.title: Ebyama bikuumibwa bulungi
principles.text: Tewali kwetaagisa akawunti wadde ebirango. Ebifaananyi byammwe tebiva ku ssimu oba ku kompyuta yammwe.

home.guidesTitle: Obukodyo obw'omugaso mu kulabirira buli lunaku

guides.title: Engeri y'okuzannyiramu emizannyo awamu
guides.text: Okutegeka, enkola ey'akasirise, n'eky'okukola singa omuzannyo guba gukomye okuba omusanyusa.

guides.title: Bwe baba bagaanye okukola ekintu
guides.text: Ensonga eza bulijjo ezibagaanyisa, n'engeri ey'ekisa ey'okugezako nate oluvannyuma.

guides.title: Emirimu gy'ebifaananyi egy'awamu
guides.text: Emirimu egy'awamu ku mmeeza eya bantu abamu, nga buli muntu alina omulimu gwe.

guides.title: Endowooza z'emirimu 101
guides.text: Endowooza ennyangu, nga zitegekeddwa ng'ebyo by'olina n'amaanyi agaliwo.

home.researchTitle: Obulamu bw'obwongo: kiki okunoonyereza kye kugamba ddala
home.researchText: Dementia eyinza okuziyizibwa? Emizannyo gy'obwongo girina kye giyamba? Ate eby'okusiiba, emmere, otulo n'okuwulira obulungi? Ebyokuddamu ebyangu era ebiriko ensibuko, nga mw'otwalidde n'awo obukakafu we bulabikira nga bunafu.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities ku iPhone, iPad ne Android
home.appText: App eno ey'obwereere ekola n'awatali yintaneeti era esobola okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka gammwe bye mulonzeeko, ebikuumibwa ku ssimu yammwe. Entegeka y'emu eteefu: obupande bunene buna, tewali saawa ebala, tewali bubonero.

faq.a: Emizannyo emirungi nga migumu, gimanyiddwa era nga tegirina kunyigirizibwa: ebifaananyi ebinene okubigattako, okusengeka, puzzle ennyangu, okumaliriza ebigambo ebimanyiddwa, okusiiga langi, bingo y'ebifaananyi n'amakaadi g'okwogera. Gisaanira bakulu bangi, nga mw'otwalidde n'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira. Okulonda okusinga obulungi kwe kumu omuntu ky'asanyukira leero. Weewale ebiseera ebipimibwa, obubonero n'ekintu kyonna ekiwulira ng'ekigezo.

Yee. Buli muzannyo n'ekipapula eky'okukuba ku Creative Activities bya bwereere, nga tewali kuteekawo akawunti, kwewandiisa, oba kussaamu kintu kyonna. Emizannyo gikolera butereevu ku mukutu gwa yintaneeti ku ssimu, tabuleeti, oba kompyuta.

Tewali mizannyo egy'olaga nti giziyiza obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era Creative Activities teyogera nti ejjanjaba oba eziyiza kintu kyonna. Emizannyo gyaffe gya kusanyusa n'okumala obudde awamu, era tewali lupapula lwa mirimu lwonna olugamba ku bujjanjabi bw'obulamu.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino gisaanira omuntu alina ekirwadde kya Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yee. Obulwadde bwa Alzheimer's bwe bumu ku businga okuleeta obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era emizannyo gyateekebwateekebwa nga bwe gisaana: ebifaananyi ebinene ebisigala nga birabika, ebyokulondako bitono, era nga tewali kintu kya kwijukira oba kusobyako. Okugatta ebifaananyi, okusengeka, n'okumaliriza engero ezimanyiddwa beesigama ku kumanya okw'edda okusinga okuyiga ebipya.

faq.q: Omuntu ali mu ddala ery'oluvannyuma ery'obulwadde bw'okwerabira asobola okukozesa emirimu gino?
faq.a: Ebiseera ebisinga, yee, ng'alina omuntu amuli ku lusegere. Tandika n'okusanga ebifaanaganye ebirimu ebifaananyi bibiri, emigogo gy'ebifaananyi n'obutundu bunna, olupapula lw'okusiigako langi, oba okuwummulamu mu kussa obulungi mu bakkakkamu. Kikuume nga kya kiseera kitono, goberera engeri gye bawuliramu, era mukome awo nga bamaze okukoowa oba okukkuta.

faq.q: Ebikwata ku nze bikuumibwa mu kyama?
faq.a: Omukutu guno tegulina bwakawunti era tegulina birango. Tukozesa Google Analytics okutegeera empapula ezikyalirwa. Ebifaananyi by'olonda ku migogo gy'ebifaananyi birabikira mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omutimbagano gyokka era tebisaasanyizibwako wadde okuteekebwa ku mutimbagano.

Creative Activities ye kibiina ekitono ekikola emirimu egy'okukola egy'abakulu, egy'emirembe, ku buli alabirira omuntu, ku mukutu ne ku pulogulaamu ey'obwereere. Ffe tuli si ba ddagala, era tewali kino kyonna kiwa magezi ga ddagala.

home.groupsLede: Tandika n'ekibinja ekikwatagana n'omuntu gw'oli naye n'ebyo by'olina. Buli lupapula lulina enkola ennyangu n'ebiragiro by'obukuumi.

groups.text: Ebikozesebwa ng'empapula, langi, ebintu eby'okuddamu okukozesa n'emirimu gy'ebiseera, nga buli emu erina enkola ennyangu.

groups.title: Abaana
groups.text: Okutonda n'okuzannya ku baana, nga omuntu omukulu ali awo kumpi, n'ebiragiro by'obukuumi ebirambika.

groups.title: Emirembe gy'okukola

listen.paused: Oyimiridde. Nyiga Ddamu okugenda mu maaso.
listen.note: Ekozesa eddoboozi ly'ekyuma kyo. Ebimu ku byuma bisindika ebigambo eri ababikola okubyogera.

playCta.title: Mwetegekedde omuzannyo ogw'empole?
playCta.text: Ebifaananyi ebinene, tewali kubala budde, tewali bubonero era tewali kwewandiisa. Zannyira awamu mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omutimbagano.

appCta.title: Genda n'emizannyo gino buli w'oba
appCta.text: Akayapuli aka Creative Activities aka bwereere aka iPhone, iPad ne Android: obufaananyi obunene, emizannyo egirimu ebifaananyi by'amaka go, n'ebibinja by'ebifaananyi ebikola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. Tewali akawunti, birango, kubala budde oba bubonero.

activities.label: Ebitabo by'emirimu
activities.title: Ebitabo by'Emirimu
activities.seo: Ebitabo by'Emirimu: Endowooza, Ebikozesebwa mu Kusiiga n'Engeri y'Okutandika
activities.description: Ebitabo ebyangu ku mirimu egy'okukola gy'oyinza okukola n'omuntu: endowooza ennyangu, ebikozesebwa mu kusiiga ku nsimbi entono, okusiiga awamu, ebbaluwa, ebijjukizo n'okunnyonnyola kw'obujjanjabi mu kusiiga.
activities.lede: Ebitabo ebimpi era ebikozesebwa ku ngeri y'okulonda n'okutandika omulimu n'omuntu, ka abe ng'akyali muto oba mukulu oba ng'alina obusobozi bw'engeri yonna.

crafts.label: Emirimu gy'emikono
crafts.title: Emirimu gy'Emikono ku Myaka Gyonna
crafts.seo: Emirimu gy'Emikono Egyangu ku Myaka Gyonna, Nga Mulimu Enkola Ennyangu
crafts.description: Emirimu gy'emikono egyangu ku bakulu, abaana n'amaka: empapula, okusiiga langi, ebintu eby'okuddamu okukozesa n'emirimu gy'ebiseera, nga mulimu enkola ennyangu okukwata n'okutuula, nga tewali bukugu bwa njawulo bwetaagisa.
crafts.lede: Emirimu egitandikira ku bintu ebisinga obungi ebiri mu maka, nga buli emu erina enkola ennyangu, omuntu yenna asobole okukola ekintu.

kids.label: Abaana
kids.title: Emirimu gy'Okukola ku Baana
kids.seo: Emirimu gy'Okukola ku Baana: Okusiiga, Okuwulira n'Emirembe
kids.description: Emirimu gy'okukola ku baana: okusiiga kw'abato, okukola n'ebintu eby'enjawulo, okuzannya n'okuwulira, emirimu gy'ennaku ez'enkuba n'endowooza z'okutereeza omwoyo, nga mulimu ebiragiro by'obukuumi n'enkola ez'abalina ebyetaago eby'okuwulira.
kids.lede: Endowooza z'okusiiga n'okuzannya eri abaana ab'emyaka n'ebyetaago eby'enjawulo, nga mulimu ebiragiro ebirambika obukuumi n'omuntu omukulu ali kumpi.

together.label: Awamu
together.title: Emirimu gy'Okukola Awamu
together.seo: Emirimu gy'Okukola Awamu, Okuyita mu Mirembe Egy'emyaka
together.description: Emirimu ku mirembe ebiri oba okusingawo: emizannyo gy'okwogera, puzzle, ebiseera ebweru, emirimu gy'abazadde n'abazzukulu, n'engeri z'okusigala nga muli kumpi ne bwe mubeera wala.
together.lede: Endowooza ez'okugabana ebiseera ne maama oba kitaawe, jjajjaabo oba jjajjaawo, omwana oba mukwano gwo, awaka, ebweru, mu kulambula oba ng'oli wala.

creative-calm.label: Emirembe gy'okukola
creative-calm.title: Emirembe gy'Okukola
creative-calm.seo: Emirembe gy'Okukola: Emirimu Egisirifu gy'Okukola n'Okuwummulamu
creative-calm.description: Emirimu egisirifu egy'okukola ku bakulu n'abo abalabirira: okusiiga nga weegendereza, okuwandiika mu katabo, ennyimba, ebiseera ebiwulirwa n'ebiro ebyesirifu. Mirimu gy'okukola, si bujjanjabi.
creative-calm.lede: Engeri ennyangu ez'okwongera ku budde n'ekkalaamu, empapula oba oluyimba. Zino ze mirimu egy'okukola, si bujjanjabi, era tezeetaagisa bukugu.

caregiving.label: Okusasula abalwadde bw'okujjukira
caregiving.title: Okulabirira Omuntu Alina Obulwadde bw'Okujjukira
caregiving.seo: Okulabirira Omuntu Alina Obulwadde bw'Okujjukira: Emizannyo n'Obuyambi
caregiving.description: Ebiwandiiko ebiyamba famire ezirabirira omuntu alina obulwadde bw'okujjukira: engeri y'okuzannyira awamu, ky'okukola bw'agaana, n'esobola okufuna obuyambi obwesigika oluvannyuma lw'okuzuulibwa kw'obulwadde.
caregiving.lede: Obuyambi obusooka ku mirimu egy'okuzannyira ku famire ezirabirira omuntu alina obulwadde bw'okujjukira, n'ebifo gy'osobola okufunira amagezi ag'obujjanjabi n'okulabirira.

brain-health.label: Obulamu bw'obwongo
brain-health.title: Obulamu bw'Obwongo: Okunoonyereza Kye Kugamba
brain-health.seo: Obulamu bw'Obwongo n'Akatyabaga k'Obulwadde bw'Okwerabira: Okunoonyereza Kye Kugamba
brain-health.description: Obulwadde bw'okwerabira buyinza okuziyizibwa? Obulagirizi obw'amazima era obwesigamiziddwa ku bujulizi ku bintu ebireeta akatyabaga, emizannyo gy'obwongo, okusiiba, emmere, okukola dduyiro, otulo, okuwulira, n'obubonero obusooka obw'okwerinda.
brain-health.lede: Okunoonyereza okunene kye kulaga mu butuufu ku kukendeeza obulabe bw'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, nga kinyonnyoddwa mu ngeri ennyangu, omuli n'ebitundu obujulizi gye bukyali obunafu oba obutali bumu. Buno bubaka bwa bulijjo, si magezi ga kisawo.

guide.sourcesNote: Tussaako ebiwandiiko eby'ebitongole n'okunoonyereza olupapula luno kwe lwesigamye. Buli kimu kyakeberwa ng'olupapula luno luzzibwa buggya.
guide.staleText: Kyakolebwa okuva ku mpapula ya Chingereza eyali yakakolebwa edda, era kati ekyuseemu. Empapula ya Chingereza y'ey'omulembe.
guide.staleHealth: Ewa amawulire ku by'obulamu, kale kebera empapula ya Chingereza era obuuze omusawo oba omuyambi w'abalwadde nga tonnakola kyonna ku ekyo.

healthNotice.title: Bubaka bwa bulijjo, si magezi ga kisawo
healthNotice.textHtml: Olupapula luno lufunza okunoonyereza okwafulumizibwa eri amaka. Terusobola kukutegeeza kituufu eri omuntu omu omu. Yogera n'omusawo nga tonnakyusa mmere, dduyiro, nneebaka, eddagala oba ebirungo ebyongerwamu. Ku bwa kibulankanya obubaluseewo amangu oba enkyukakyuka endala ez'embagirawo, funa obujjanjabi bw'abasawo mbagirawo. Soma okumanyisa kwaffe ku bubaka bw'obulamu.

about.bodyHtml:
Ani gwe kikwatako

Buli muntu alabirira omuntu: kitaawe oba maama, jjajja oba jjajjaabe, omwana, munne mu bufumbo, mukwano, oba omuntu alina obulwadde bw'okujjukira. Famire, abantu abakulu, n'abakozi b'emirimu bonna basobola okukozesa empapula zimu.

Kye twekkiriza

Ensonga y'emirimu gye gunnaku yennyini: okwogera, okumwenya, essanyu ery'okussa ebifaananyi bibiri awamu, oba okutuula awamu nga muli kumpi. Si kugezesa muntu, si kumusindika okusinga, wadde okukakasa ekintu kyonna.

Emikutu mingi egy'okutendeka ebirowoozo gikolebwa okusinziira ku sipiidi, emiwendo, ennaku ezitamenyeddwa n'emitendera. Eri omuntu anakooye, alwadde oba alina obulwadde bw'okujjukira, ekyo kiyinza okuba ng'ekigezo ky'atasobola kuyisa. Ffe twakola ekyawukana ku ekyo, era twesibidde ku mateeka gano:

  • Tewali kya kufaayo. Tewali saawa, kigero, kubala kwa nkyukakyuka, obulamu, ennaku ezitamenyeddwa, ebiragiro ebyaka oba ebiseera ebikendeera, ku ssirini yonna.
  • Okutegeera kusinga okujjukira. Ebifaananyi bisigala nga bilabika ng'ensi yonna. Ebikubirizo bikubiriza okwogera era tebibuuza mannya oba ebijjukizo.
  • Binene, byangu era binywevu. Ebiwandiiko ebinene n'ebifaananyi, langi ez'enjawulo, n'ebikwata ebisigala mu kifo kye kimu.
  • Ekitiibwa ky'omuntu omukulu. Ebifaananyi eby'obulamu obwa nnaku, n'ebigambo ebyangu era ebibuddamu obukkakkamu. Tewali bifaananyi bya katuuni, tewali kutendereza mu ddoboozi ery'ennyimba oba empeera za emoji.
  • Ekkubo ery'angu okuva. “Mu kiseera kino maliridde” kisigala nga kiraga bulungi. Okuyimiriza wakati kiva mu bulungi.
  • Kwekuuma nga kwa kyama. Tewali bukakafu bwa akawunti oba ssente z'okulangirira. Ebifaananyi by'olonda bisigala ku kyuma kyo.

Ebyo bye tutakakasa

Emizannyo n'emirimu gyaffe gya ssanyu n'okukwatagana. Tegizuula, tegeza, tegipima, tejjanjaba, tekendeeza oba tegiziyiza bulwadde bw'okujjukira oba bulwadde bwa Alzheimer, so tewali asaanidde kugilonda olw'ensonga eyo. Bwe twogera ku bunoonyereza bw'obulamu, tuyogera mu butongole nga obukakafu buliko obunafu, era tetugakwatako ku mirimu gyaffe.

Ffe be tuli

Creative Activities ttiimu ntono ey'ebyetongodde. Tetuli basawo. Empapula zaffe ziwandiikibwa okusinziira ku biragiro ebyasiddwa mu lujjudde ebitegekeddwa ebitongole ng'ekitongole ekya National Institute on Aging ne Alzheimer's Association, era buli mpapula etegeeza ensibuko zaayo. Soma engeri gye tuwandiikamu ne gye tukeberamu empapula zaffe.

Tutegeeze ebiyinza okuyamba

Twagala nnyo okuwulira ebikola gy'oli n'ebitakola, naddala okuva eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okujjukira, abalabirira famire n'abakozi b'emirimu. Wandiika ku {email}.

editorial.title: Engeri Gye Tuwandiikamu n'Okwekebejja Empapula Zaffe
editorial.description: Creative Activities ekola kunoonyereza, ewandiika, efuna ensibuko era ezzaawo empapula zaayo ez'emirimu n'obulamu, n'ebyo bye tetujja kigenda kufulumya.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Ebibuuzo n'Ebyokuddamu
faq.description: Eby'okuddamu ku bibuuzo ebitera okubuuzibwa ku mizannyo n'emirimu: ki ky'olina okugezaako, okuzannya okumala ebbanga ki, ebibinja n'ebirowoozo eby'emitendera egisembayo, obulamu n'obwama.
faq.lede: Ebyokuddamu ebyangu era ebimpi ku bibuuzo abalabirira abalala bye batera okubuuza ennyo.

items.q: Mizannyo ki esinga obulungi eri abantu abakulu?
items.a: Emizannyo egisinga obulungi gye gyo egimanyiddwa, egyangu era egitateeka muntu ku puleesa, era omutuufu gwe gwo gw'anyumirwa leero. Okugatta ebifaananyi ebyolekeddwa, okusengeka, ebizannyo ebyangu eby'okugatta ebitundu, okumaliriza eŋŋero n'enjogera ezimanyiddwa, okusiiga langi, ssaako bbingo ey'ebifaananyi, byonna bikolera bulungi abantu bangi. Weewale ssaawa ezibala, obubonero, ne kintu kyonna ekirabika ng'ekigezo.
Yee. Emizannyo gyonna n'ebintu eby'okukuba ku mpapula bya bwereere, nga tewali kwetaagisa kuggulawo akawunti, kwewandiisa, kutikkula kintu wadde ebirango.

items.q: Lwaki tewali kubala bubonero, madaala oba bipimo bya budde?
items.a: Embiro n'obubonero bifuula eky'okusanyusa okuba ng'ekigezo, ekiyinza okuleeta ensonyi oba okunyiiga. Essira tulissa ku ssanyu n'okumala obudde awamu, n'olwekyo tewali kintu kya kugwamu era muyinza okuyimiriza ekiseera kyonna kye mwagala.

Essimu yonna, taabuleti oba kompyuta eriko pulogulaamu y'omukutu gwa yintaneeti ey'omulembe. Taabuleti eteekeddwa ku kuteekako ku mmeeza kitera okuba ekyangu era ekirungi abantu babiri okuzannyira awamu nga batudde wamu. Kompyuta eya laputo eyungiddwa ku ttivi ekola bulungi eri ebibinja.

Yee. Photo pairs efuula ebifaananyi 2 okutuuka ku 6 by'olonda okuba omuzannyo gw'okugattako ebyefaanaanyiriza. Ebifaananyi bisigala mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu era tebitikkulwa ku mpewo wadde okuterekebwa.

Katera okumala eddakiika 10 okutuuka ku 20, era oluusi eddakiika 2 ziba zimala obulungi. Kebera obubonero obw'obukoowu oba okunyiiga era muyimirize ng'ekyali kisanyusa. Tewali kiseera kigambibwa nti kye kigwanidde.

items.q: Bwe baba tebaagala kwenyigira mu muzannyo?
items.a: Wuliriza era osseemu ekitiibwa okugaana kwabwe, era muzzeemu okugezaako eddako oba mu ngeri endala. Okugaana kuyinza okuva ku bukoowu, obulumi, obutategeera bulungi oba obutaba na kyagalo. Laba obulagirizi bwaffe obukwata ku kiki eky'okukola nga bagaanye.

items.q: Mizannyo ki egisaana abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira obutuuse mu ddaala ery'oku nkomerero?
items.a: Ebireeta ekiwummulo n'eby'okukwatako: okuwuliriza ennyimba ze baagala, okubakwasa mu ngalo n'ebizigo, okutunulira awamu ebifaananyi, okukwata ku bulangiti ennyirivu, okutuula ebweru, oba omuzannyo gw'ebifaananyi omwangu ennyo ng'omuntu ali wamu nabo. Obulagirizi bwaffe obw'eddaala ery'oku nkomerero bulina ebirowoozo ebirala bingi.

items.q: Waliwo emizannyo egisaana ebibinja by'abantu mu mayumba agalabirirwamu abakadde?
items.a: Yee. Omuzannyo gwa Picture bingo gulina kaada ezikubibwa ku mpapula n'omulamuzi alabikira ku sikuliini, ate Finish the saying ne kaada ez'emboozi zikola bulungi nga zisomebwa mu ddoboozi ery'omwanguka. Obulagirizi bwaffe obw'ebibinja mu mayumba agalabirira abakadde bulaga obunene bw'ekibinja, entuula, n'engeri y'okukikyusaamu okusinziira ku busobozi bw'abantu abenjawulo.

items.q: Emizannyo giyinza okuziyiza oba okulwisa obulwadde bw'okwerabira?
items.a: Tewali muzannyo galagiddwa nti guziyiza bulwadde bwa kwerabira, era emizannyo gyaffe tegiwoza nti gikola ekyo. Okukozesa obwongo nga muli wamu n'abalala kulaze akagaso akatono mu kunoonyereza eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira obutannakula nnyo, naye ekyo kya njawulo ku muzannyo okuziyiza obulwadde. Tuwaayo emizannyo gino lwa ssanyu n'okunyweza enkolagana.

Tekinnakakasibwa ddala. Okunoonyereza kwekuusa ku bintu 14 ebikwata ku bulamu n'embeera z'obulamu ezongeza obulabe bw'okufuna obulwadde bw'okwerabira, gamba ng'okufa amatu, puleesa ey'omuggundu, obutakola dduyiro, n'okubeera wekka awatali bantu. Okukola ku bintu bino kiyinza okukendeeza ku bulabe eri abantu abamu, naye abantu bangi abakola buli kimu mu butuufu bakyafuna obulwadde buno. Si nsobi ya muntu yenna.

items.q: Okusiiba okw'ebiseera ebipime kulungi ku bulamu bw'obwongo?
items.a: Obukakafu obukwata ku bantu butono nnyo era bukyali buyaaye, era okunoonyereza okusinga kuli ku bisolo. Okusiiba kuyenze okubaamu obulabe eri abantu abakulu, naddala abakozesa eddagala lya sukaali oba abagenda nga bakogga awatali kutegeka, era tekuweebwa birowoozo eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira. Yogera n'omusawo nga tonnakyusa ngeri gy'olyangamu.

items.q: Waliwo ebikwata ku bantu bye mukunganya?
items.a: Tewali kawunti wadde ebirango. Tukozesa Google Analytics okubala abakyala n'okulaba empapula ezisinga okuyamba, ate pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu ejjukira oba wakoleeza amaloboozi amagonvu. Ebifaananyi by'olonda ku Photo pairs tebitikkulwako ku mpewo wadde katono. Laba ebiragiro by'ebyama okumanya ebisingawo.
Nedda. Creative Activities eriwo lwa kwesanyusa n'okumanya okwa bulijjo. Ku bibuuzo ebikwata ku bulamu, yogera n'omusawo, ate mu mbeera ey'amangu ennyo kubira 112.

faq.moreHtml: Ebisingawo: engeri y'okuzannyira awamu, bw'agaana, emirimu gy'emitendera egisembayo ne emirimu gy'obulwadde bw'okujjukira mu maka.

handout.title: Emizannyo egy'obwereere era emigonvu eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira
handout.seoTitle: Omupapula ogukubibwako: Emizannyo egy'obwereere egy'obulwadde bw'okwerabira ku yintaneeti
handout.description: Omupapula gwa lupapula lumu ogukubibwako ogw'amaka n'abalabirira abantu obukwata ku mizannyo gy'ebifaananyi egy'obwereere era emigonvu eri abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, ogukozesebwa mu bibinja ebibayambako n'ebikozesebwa mu kulabirira.
handout.lede: Kuba olupapula luno olw'ekibinja ekikola ku by'okuyambagana, ensawo z'eby'okulabirira oba okulukwata ku mulyango gw'afirigi. Kozesa ekiragiro kya Print mu pulogulaamu yo ey'omukutu gwa yintaneeti; emmeeza z'ebiragiro n'obupeeso tebirabika ku lupapula olukubiddwa.
handout.introHtml: Ebifaananyi ebinene, ebigambo ebyangu era tewali kintu kya kugwamu. Bya bwereere ku ssimu, taabuleti oba kompyuta, awatali kwewandiisa, tewali birango, tewali bipimo bya budde era tewali kubala bubonero. Mutuule wamu era muzannye nga mukolagana mu kussaako obudde.
handout.restHtml:
Amagezi amatono

  • Londa ekiseera ky'olunaku omuntu gw'olabirira w'awulirira obulungi ennyo.
  • Tandika n'enkwatagana esinga obwangu. Obupande buna bumala obulungi.
  • Munyuumye ku bifaananyi ebyo. Emboozi etera okuba ekitundu ekisinga obulungi.
  • Muyimirize nga kikyali kisanyusa. Okukomekkereza amangu kiba kirungi nnyo.

Ebirala ebiri ku mukutu guno

  • Ebintu eby'obwereere eby'okukuba ku mpapula: okunoonya ebigambo mu nnukuta ennene, empapula ez'okusiiga langi, kaada ez'emboozi ne Picture bingo.
  • Ebirowoozo by'emizannyo ku buli ddaala, n'obulagirizi ku ngeri y'okuzannyiramu awamu n'okwelabirira wekka.

Biriwo lwa ssanyu n'okuba awamu mu kiseera ekyo. Si magezi ga kisawo, si kigezo wadde obujjanjabi. Creative Activities efulumizibwa Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.description: Engeri amakaye g'abalabirira, enteekateeka z'emisana ez'abantu abakulu, amasomero, ebitongole by'abakadde n'ebibinja by'obuyambi gye bakozesaamu emizannyo gyaffe egy'obwereere n'empapula z'emirimu, awamu n'ebigambo ebinaakuyingiza ku lukalala lw'ebiyambo.
organizations.lede: Buli ekiri ku mukutu guno kya bwereere okukozesa n'abantu ababeera mu maka g'abakadde, bammemba n'abantu b'olabirira, nga tewali kwetaagisa kuggulawo akaawunti, layisinsi oba kusasula bisale. Omuko guno gunnyonnyola ebiri wano n'engeri y'okubigabaniramu n'abalala.
organizations.shortText: {name}: emizannyo egy'ebifaananyi egy'obwereere, egy'obukkakkamu n'empapula z'emirimu eri abakadde, famire n'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okujjukira. Tewali kwewandiisa, tewali saawa, tewali biwandiiko.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) ekola emizannyo {count} ez'obwereere ez'okukolera ku mutimbagano eri abakadde, amaka n'abantu ababeera n'obulwadde bwa dementia, omuli emizannyo gy'okukwatagana ebifaananyi nga ebifaananyi bisigala nga bilabika, okusiiga ebitundu by'ekifaananyi okwangu, okugatta ebintu, enjogera ezimanyiddwa n'emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi ebya bingo n'amakaadi agasobola okusiimbwa. Tewali akaonti, matangazo, sawuro wadde ebiwandiiko. Omukutu era gulina ebiwandiiko ebyangu ku bikolwa eby'amaka, abakadde n'abakozi, nga birimu ensibuko ng'ekitongole kya National Institute on Aging ne Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Emizannyo {count} egikolerwa ku yintaneeti egikola ku kompyuta ey'omu ngalo, tebuleti oba ttivi eyungiddwa ku kompyuta. Tewali kwetaagisa kussaamu pulogulaamu, kaawunti oba kukoppa ku kyuma. Laba emizannyo gyonna.
organizations.printablesAfter: Kozesa eppeesa erya Print ku buli muko.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Engeri z'ekibinja: Bingo y'ebifaananyi erina amakaadi agasobola okusiimbwa n'omuwandiise ku ssirini, ate emizannyo gy'okwogera erina ebibuuzo n'ebyokuddamu ebiri okulonda, n'ebintu by'okwogerako.
  • Ebiwandiiko by'ebikolwa eby'abakozi n'amaka, nga biwandiikiddwa mu lulimi olwangu nga birimu ensibuko. Tandika ne ebikolwa 101 oba ebikolwa by'ekibinja mu bifo by'okulabirira.
organizations.restHtml:
Engeri ebibiina gye bikikozesaamu

  • Amaka g'abakadde n'ag'abalabirirwa olw'okwerabira: bingo y'ebifaananyi oba okumaliriza engero ku ttivi ey'omu kisenge eky'awamu, ng'omuntu omu y'anyiga ku sikuliini ku lwa banne.
  • Enkola ez'emisana ez'abakulu: ekifo ekiriko tebuleti eriko omuzannyo gw'okugatta ebifaananyi ebifaanagana nga gutereddwa ku bifaananyi bina, olw'okuzannya okumpi wakati w'abantu babiri.
  • Amaterekero g'ebitabo ag'olukale: emizannyo gy'okunoonya ebigambo egyakubibwa ku lupapula ne kkaadi ez'okunyumyako mu bikozesebwa eby'okujjukiza, n'omukutu nga gutereddwa ku tebuleti z'etterekero ly'ebitabo.
  • Ebibiina ebibeerawo abalabirizi n'ebifo eby'okunyumirwamu n'okujjukiza: akapepala ak'omuko gumu akayinza okukubibwa ku lupapula ak'amaka okutwala awaka.
  • Amalwaliro n'abateekateeka okusiibula abalwadde: akapepala kano kateekebwa mu bipapula ebiweebwa abalabirizi, okufuna ekintu ekikkakkamu eky'okukola awaka oba ku kitanda.

Kye tutakola

Emizannyo gino gya kwesanyusaamu n'okumalira awamu ebiseera. Tegikebera, tegigezesa, tegiwa bubonero, tegijjanjaba era tegikendeeza ku kusensera kw'obulwadde bw'okwerabira, era tusaba ebitongole obutagannyonnyola mu ngeri eyo. Tewali birango, era emizannyo tegusaba mannya, bikwata ku bulamu oba kuteekako bifaananyi. Omukutu guno gukozesa Google Analytics okubala abagukyalira; obubaka bwaffe obukwata ku byama bunnyonnyola ebyo ebikunganyizibwa. Ebifaananyi ebikozesebwa mu Photo pairs bisigala mu bulawuza yo.

Tussa ku lukalala lwo olw'ebiyamba

Bw'oba ng'olina olukalala lw'ebiyamba abalabirizi, oyaniirizibwa nnyo okussaako enkolagana egenda ku {domain}. Osobola okukoppa ennyonnyola yonna ku zino eziri wano.
organizations.linksHtml:
Empapula ezikwata obulungi okusalirawo ddala: emizannyo gy'obwereere, ebiwandiiko ebiteekeddwa okusiimbwa obwereere, ebikolwa bya dementia awaka ne engeri y'okuzannyiramu awamu.

Ebibuuzo oba okutereeza

Singa waliwo ekitali kituufu oba ekitategeerekeka ku mukutu, oba obwetaavu bw'omubeezi oba omulwadde tebutuukiridde ku ebyo ebiriwo, tugamba otubuulire ku {email}. Tewali kubaako bantu bwe tuli tukusaba obutaweereza bikwata ku bantu oba ku by'obulamu by'ababeezi oba abasasulwa.

app.title: App ya Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: App ya Creative Activities eya iPhone ne Android
app.description: App ya Creative Activities ey'obwereere: okugatta ebifaananyi okwangu n'obutundutundu obunene buna, ebifaananyi by'amaka bisigala ku ssimu yo, ebibinja by'ebifaananyi ebikola nga tewali yintaneeti, era nga tewali kwetaagisa kaawunti.
app.lede: Buli ky'osiima ku mukutu guno, kiri mu app ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti era eyinza okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonzeemu.
app.bodyHtml:
Tandikira ku bitono

Tandika n'ebipande bina ebinene n'ebifaananyi ebimanyiddwa obulungi. Leka ebifaananyi nga birabika, oba bibikke singa ekyo kiba kisingako obweyamo. Enkola ey'obuteefu terina kubala budde, bubonero wadde ebibonerezo. Londa ebipande 4, 6, 8 oba 12.

Kifuule eky'amaka gammwe

Londa ebifaananyi by'amaka ng'okozesa etterekero ly'ebifaananyi ku kyuma kyo. Pulogulamu etereka koppi entonotono olw'emirimu gyayo. Tekebera tterekero lyo lyonna wadde okukyusa ebifaananyi byo ebyasooka, era etereka ebifaananyi okutuuka ku 24 mu lukung’aanyizo olumu.

Mutunuulire wamu

Mutunuulire ekifaananyi kimu ku mulundi. Ebibuuzo ebitali bya buwaze biyingiza emboozi awatali kusaba muntu kujjukira mannya oba kuwa kuddamu kutuufu. Okubitunuulirako kwokka kimala.

Kikola ne bwe wataba yintaneeti

Ebifaananyi eby'okutandikirako wamu n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi byonna omunaana biri mu pulogulamu. Koppi z'ebifaananyi by'oyingizaamu zikola ne bwe wataba yintaneeti. Okulonda ebifaananyi ebisookerwako ebiterekeddwa mu iCloud yokka kiyinza okwetaagisa yintaneeti.

Tewali kwewandiisa, tewali ssaava ezikwataganya bifaananyi

Koppi z'ebifaananyi by'amaka zisigala mu pulogulamu ku kyuma kyo. Osobola okuggyamu koppi zino awatali kusazaamu bifaananyi byo ebyasooka. Kookopi z'okukuuma ebyuma ziyinza okubaamu data wa pulogulamu eno. Soma enkola y'obukuumi bw'ebikwata ku bakozesa, era obuyambi bwa pulogulamu bukulaga buli mutendera.
app.disclaimer: Creative Activities eriwo lwa kwesanyusa n'okunyumyamu wamu. Tesobola kukebera, kujjanjaba, kuziyiza wadde okupima obulwadde bw'okwerabira oba obwa Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.title: Emizannyo gy'obwereere gy'okuzannyira awamu ku mutimbagano
gamesIndex.description: Emizannyo gya yintaneti egy'obwereere eri abakadde, amaka n'abantu ababeera n'obulwadde bwa dementia: okukwatagana ebifaananyi, ebigatta ebitundu ebyangu, okugatta ebintu, enjogera, okusiiga langi ne bingo. Tewali kwewandiisa, sawuro wadde ebiwandiiko.
gamesIndex.lede: Emizannyo {count} egy'obwereere gy'osobola okuzannyira awamu mu mukutu gwo ogwa yintaneeti. Ebifaananyi ebinene, ebigambo ebyangu, era tewali ky'ogwamu: tewali kubala budde, tewali bubonero, era tewali kwewandiisa.
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Emitendera gino kyakuyambako bugoba. Goberera ebyo omuntu gw'olabirira by'anyumirwa n'ebyo ebimuweereza obuteefu leero.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Ebirala ebitali ku ssirini: ebikolwa 101, ebikolwa bya dementia awaka ne emirimu gy'emikono.

faq.a: Okugatta ebifaananyi ebigwaŋŋana ng'okozesa ebipande bina kye kisinga obuteefu okutandikirako. Singa okulonda wakati w'ebifaananyi kiba kizibu nnyo, gezaako Noonya ekifaanagana n'ebifaananyi bibiri. Bwe muba ekibinja, mugezeko Bingo y'ebifaananyi.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino gikola ku iPad oba ku ssimu?
faq.a: Ye. Buli muzannyo gukola mu mukutu gw'akalombolombo ku masimu, ku tablet ne ku kompyuta, era ebifaananyi byegaziya ne bijjula essiikirini. Okuteeka tablet ku kintu ekiyimiridde kye kitera okuba ekiwummuliza ennyo eri abantu babiri.

faq.q: Emizannyo gino mirungi eri omuntu alina obulwadde bwa Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ye. Gyakolebwa olw'abantu abalina obulwadde bw'okwerabira, omuli ne Alzheimer, ekisinga okubuleeta. Ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika, eriyo eby'okulondako bitono nnyo, era tewali kubala budde wadde bubonero, n'olwekyo emizannyo gino gisinzira ku kutegeera bintu ebimanyiddwa mu kifo ky'okujjukira ebipya.

Gye mizannyo gy'okukwatagana n'ebifaananyi, omukadde yenna ky'asobola okusanyukiramu, naye gikoleddwa obutagezesa ntegeera: mu Picture pairs ebifaananyi bisigala nga bitunuulidde waggulu okuggyako nga walonze bulala. Buli mizannyo gy'okujjukira egiyinza okufuuka egy'obusaasizi nga oggyeeko sawuro n'obubonero.

faq.q: Waliyo emizannyo egy'ebibinja mu maka g'abakadde abalabirirwa?
faq.a: Ye. Bingo y'ebifaananyi erina kaada z'osobola okukubisa ku lupapula n'omukozi alabika ku ssiikirini, era Maliriza olugero ne Kaada z'okunyumyamu zikola bulungi nnyo nga zisomeddwa mu ddoboozi erivuga eri ekibinja.

appFacts.requirements: iOS 15 oba esingako; Android 7.0 oba esingako
appFacts.summary: Pulogulamu ya bwereere ey'a iPhone, iPad ne Android eriko okugatta ebifaananyi mu ngeri ey'obuteefu ku bipande ebinene bina okutuuka ku kkumi n'ebibiri, okugatta n'okutunuulira ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olondawo, n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi omunaana ebiweereddwa ebikola awatali yintaneeti. Tewali kwewandiisa, birango, kubala budde oba bubonero.
features: Okugatta ebifaananyi mu ngeri ey'obuteefu n'ebipande ebinene 4, 6, 8 oba 12; ebifaananyi bisigala nga birabika okuggyako nga weeronderedde okubibikka
Ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olondawo bikoppebwa mu pulogulamu eno olw'okugatta wamu n'okubitunuulira awamu
Mutunuulire wamu: ekifaananyi kimu ku mulundi nga kiriko n'ebibuuzo ebitali bya buwaze ebisitula emboozi
Ebitebe by'ebifaananyi omunaana ebiri mu pulogulamu eno; bikola awatali yintaneeti
Tewali kwewandiisa, birango, kugula bintu mu pulogulamu, kubala budde, bubonero wadde ebibonerezo

faq.a: Ye. Creative Activities (eragiddwa nga "{storeName}") ya bwereere ku App Store ne Google Play. Ewaayo enkola ey'obuteefu ey'okugatta ebifaananyi n'ebipande ebinene, emizannyo gy'ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olondawo, n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi ebikola awatali yintaneeti.

faq.q: Pulogulamu ya Creative Activities ya bwereere?
faq.a: Ye. Ya bwereere okugiwanula, tewali birango, kwewandiisa wadde okugula ebintu munda mu pulogulamu.

Ye. Ebifaananyi eby'okutandikirako n'ebitebe by'ebifaananyi byonna omunaana biri mu pulogulamu, era ebifaananyi by'amaka bikola awatali yintaneeti kasita biba nga bimaze okukoppebwa mu pulogulamu. Okulonda ekifaananyi ekiterekeddwa mu iCloud yokka kiyinza okwetaagisa yintaneeti.

Ye. Londa ebifaananyi ng'okozesa ekitundu eky'okulonderamu ebifaananyi ku kyuma kyo. Pulogulamu eno etereka kopi entonotono ku kyuma kyo ez'emikolo gyayo, tezitikka ku yintaneeti era tekyusa bifaananyi byo ebyasooka. Osobola okuggyamu kopi ezo ekiseera kyonna.

faq.q: Eno pulogulamu ey'okutendeka obwongo oba okupima obusobozi bw'okujjukira?
faq.a: Nedda. Creative Activities eriwo lwa ssanyu n'okumalira ebiseera awamu. Terina bubonero wadde okupima kwonna, era tekebera, tezijjanjaba, teziyiza wadde okupima obuzibu obw'okwerabira obwa dementia oba obulwadde bwa Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.a: Ye. Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Creative Activities ey'oku iPhone, iPad ne Android erina omukolo gwe gumu ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe, esobola okukozesa ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonda, era ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti. Tewali kwetaagisa akawunti, birango wadde obubonero.

gameFaqNo.a: Si gwa muzannyo guno. Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Creative Activities ey'oku iPhone, iPad ne Android erina omukolo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe nga guli ku bufo obunene n'ebifaananyi by'amaka by'olonda, era ekola ne bwe waba tewali yintaneeti. Omuzannyo guno gusigala gwa bwereere wano mu browser yo.

gamePage.noscript: Omuzannyo guno gwetaaga okussaako JavaScript mu browser yo. Amagezi agali wansi gakola ne bwe waba teeriiko.
gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Olina obuggya mu kuzannya n'omukadde oba omuntu abeera n'obulwadde bwa dementia? Soma engeri y'okuzannyiramu emizannyo awamu, omuli ky'okukola singa bategeera obubi okuzannya.
gamePage.appText: Pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Creative Activities erina omukolo ogw'okugatta ebifaananyi eby'emirembe nga guli ku bufo obunene n'ebifaananyi by'amaka go byennyini, era ekola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad ne Android.
gamePage.photoAppText: Mu pulogulamu ya bwereere eya Creative Activities, ebifaananyi by'olonda bisigala ku kyuma kyo okutuusa ekiseera ekirala, era emizannyo gikola nga tewali Wi‑Fi. iPhone, iPad ne Android.
gamePage.goodToKnowText: Omuzannyo guno guliwo lwa ssanyu n'okumalira ebiseera awamu. Tegukebera, tegupima wadde okujjanjaba kintu kyonna.

print.heading: Zannya ku lupapula
print.sameRules: Enkyusa ey'olupapula erina amateeka ga ng'omuzannyo ogurimu ku ssirini:
print.pageNote: Olupapula lumu ku A4 oba US Letter, lulungi mu langi enzirugavu n'ekitangaala. Enkyusa {date}.
print.islandNote: Esindika ekiri ku ssirini kati. Enkyusa {date}.
print.point: Ku lupapula, lagira ekifaananyi mu kifo ky'okukinyiga, oba okikolezaako ekkalaamu. Buli layini y'ekibinja kipya.
print.pointTarget: Ku lupapula, ekifaananyi ky'olina okutunuulira kiri mu kasanduuko ku ntandikwa ya buli layini. Lagira ekifaananyi mu kifo ky'okukinyiga, oba okikolezaako ekkalaamu.
print.halves: Buli kifaananyi kisaliddwa wakati. Kola layini okuva ku buli kitundu ku mukono ogwa kkono okutuuka ku kitundu ekikwatagana ku ddyo, oba lagira n'engalo. Tekyetaagisa kusala.
print.grid: Buli kasanduuko kalina namba. Noonya namba eyo mu nkyukakyuka, olwo oloke kasanduuko n'omusizi ogw'ekyo langi. Langi endala yonna nayo esaana. Tekyetaagisa kusala.
print.colors: Buli layini eyogera langi. Lagira buli kifaananyi ekiri ku langi eyo, oba okikolezaako ekkalaamu. Buli layini y'ekibinja kipya.
print.dice: Buli layini kibinja kya dayisi. Londa layini, oba sala ebifaananyi olonde ebimu mu kibinja, olwo mwogere ekintu ekikwata ku byo mu nkola yonna. Buli muntu asobola okuyisa.
print.words: Sala ebigambo, oba kola layini okuva ku buli kigambo okutuuka ku kifaananyi kyakyo. Soma ebigambo mu ddoboozi nga bwe mugenda mu maaso.
print.cards: Sala amakaadi ku layini ez'ekiwumbi. Gateeke waggulu ku mmeeza, olwo mulonde ebikwatagana.
print.chain: Ku lupapula, soma ebifaananyi okuva ku kkono okudda ku ddyo, kimu ku kirala. Buli muntu ayogera ekigambo kimu ku bifaananyi ebiri waggulu, olwo alagira ekifaananyi ekiddako. Buli muntu asobola okuyisa.
print.sort: Sala ebifaananyi ku layini ez'ekiwumbi, olwo buli kimu kiteeke mu kasanduuko gye kisaana.
print.puzzle: Sala ekifaananyi ekinene ku layini ez'ekiwumbi mu bitundu bina, obikutte. Kyusa bitundu bibiri mu kiseera okutuusa ekifaananyi lwe kiba kikyali kimu. Ekifaananyi ekitono kiba kyakulungamya.
print.cutSafety: Omuyambi ayinza okusala ng'omutandika. Oluvannyuma, ssa emmunyeenye ezisala mu kifo kyazo.

reasons.photos: Tewali nkyusa ya lupapula. Omuzannyo guno gukozesa ebifaananyi byo, ebisigala mu browser yo era tebitikkibwa, kale omukutu tegusobola kubisindika. Okuzannya ku lupapula, sindika kopi bbiri za bifaananyi ebimu by'oyagala awaka, obikwataganye ku mmeeza.
reasons.paced: Tewali nkyusa ya lupapula. Ekisanja kiteeka sipiidi ennyonjo era ennungi ku ssirini, era olupapula olulimu tekiyinza kukikola, kale kiba mulimu gwa njawulo. Okuwummula mu bukkakkamu awamu awatali ssirini kisobola bulijjo.
reasons.turns: Tewali nkyusa ya lupapula ey'omuzannyo guno. Okuzuula ebikwatagana ku mmeeza, sindika amakaadi g'ebifaananyi okuva mu Picture pairs mulyoke mukyuse okugakyusa waggulu.
reasons.screen: Ebyo tebiriiwo mu kitabo. Kino kifaananira ekifaananyi eky'okulaba awamu ku ssirini; ekifaananyi ky'omu bitabo ekyo wamu ku mmeeza nakyo kikola ekintu kye kimu.
reasons.wash: Ebyo tebiriiwo mu kitabo. Langi ya watercolor ku lupapula nayo nsonga y'emu: bulawuzi ennyogovu ne langi emu emu buli mulundi.
reasons.sayings: Ebyo tebinnabaawo mu kitabo. Ku lupapula buli nkomerero yandilabiseemu wamu, era ekitundu ekiwombeefu ekya "Laga enkomerero" kyandibuze. Soma enjogera ku ssirini wamu, oba mugabanye ezimu ze mwombi mumanyi.
